As you know, the new usage-based billing meter has passed its sandbox integration tests, and we're targeting next month's billing cycle for launch. I've got the current draft in front of me — it proposes an immediate broad launch, two-decimal half-up rounding, 90 days of raw usage-event retention, and no mandatory invoice-preview review. Before I make a final decision on the launch plan, I need to check with each of you: billing engineering, finance operations, privacy, and customer support. I'd like to walk through the key elements of this draft and hear your thoughts so I can sign off with confidence. Who'd like to kick us off?
